tools.name: find_agent_alternative
tools.description: Find a machine-friendly way into a site instead of scraping its HTML: llms.txt, /.well-known/mcp.json, agents.json, openapi.json, ai-plugin.json, and MCP URLs listed in llms.txt. Read-only.

tools.name: check_many
tools.description: Run check_agent_access on up to 10 URLs at once (counts as 1 call). Use it to pick which sources an agent can actually use.

tools.name: usage_and_upgrade
tools.description: Show today's usage for your key or IP and the $9/month upgrade link. Free tier: 50 calls/day. Not metered.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_agent_access" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Before an agent browses or fetches a site, check if it will get in. Fetches the URL as an AI agent and as a browser, detects bot challenges (CAPTCHAs, DataDome,…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
